people.name: Stephanas
people.line: Corinthian believer, baptized by Paul, sent to visit him.

translations.web: (I also baptized the household of Stephanas; besides them, I don’t know whether I baptized any other.)
translations.bsb: Yes, I also baptized the household of Stephanas; beyond that I do not remember if I baptized anyone else.
translations.kjv: And I baptized also the household of Stephanas: besides, I know not whether I baptized any other.
translations.asv: And I baptized also the household of Stephanas: besides, I know not whether I baptized any other.
